confidence_notes: Restaurant, beer, coffee and wine anchors rest on a few web search snippets (travel guides, one Petone venue menu, and Expatistan) with mixed dates, so they are bounded estimates. The cocktail anchor is weak: it is based on a single Expatistan figure and a beer-to-cocktail relationship, not a verified local cocktail price list. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the Wellington context; no accommodation searches or live listings were checked. NZD-to-USD conversion for the local-currency figures used general knowledge, not a verified rate.
comparable_city_reasoning: Local-currency basis: Wellington guides and venue menus (craft pint about NZ$12-16, flat white about NZ$6.50-8, food-truck or market meal about NZ$15-25, wine by the glass about NZ$10-17, cocktail about NZ$18). Sit-down dinner pricing was anchored to the Auckland mid-range three-course range (about NZ$75-110 per person), since guides say Wellington restaurant prices track Auckland. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a mid-sized New Zealand capital with a substantial hostel stock.
